description: This file defines functions and variables related to generating, parsing, and validating pseudo-versions in Go modules, including regex validation, version formatting, and version analysis.

methods.name: PseudoVersion
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-version string based on major version, older version, timestamp, and revision.

methods.name: ZeroPseudoVersion
methods.description: Returns a pseudo-version with zero timestamp and revision as a placeholder.

methods.name: IsPseudoVersion
methods.description: Checks if a version string is a valid pseudo-version.

methods.name: IsZeroPseudoVersion
methods.description: Checks if a version is a zero pseudo-version with default timestamp and revision.

methods.name: PseudoVersionTime
methods.description: Extracts the timestamp from a pseudo-version.

methods.name: PseudoVersionRev
methods.description: Extracts the revision identifier from a pseudo-version.

methods.name: PseudoVersionBase
methods.description: Returns the base version upon which the pseudo-version is based.
